unit_note: A finding pair is an object inside a case. Multiple findings are not additional studies. One paper pair may contain more than one question.
direction_pattern_note: opposite records an apparent difference in the reported direction. It is not by itself a scientific contradiction.
magnitude_rule: Direct numeric comparison needs a compatible outcome, comparator, scale, and time. A pooled effect needs further statistical assumptions. The same reported direction is not the same measurement.
program_checks: Programs check logical dependencies, missing-state labels, and units. They do not replace a scientific compatibility judgement.
